app.name: Barruu
app.tagline: Learn science and engineering by doing.
lang.machineDraft: This language is machine-translated and not yet reviewed.
home.title: Understand it by building it.
home.subtitle: Short, hands-on lessons for grades 9–12: build shapes, run experiments and test ideas — with instant feedback on every step. Works in your browser, even offline.
home.placementPitch: Not sure where to start? A short adaptive quiz finds your level in about 10 questions.
home.how.title: Every lesson is something you do
home.how.predict.body: Commit to a guess first. Being wrong first makes the right idea stick.
home.how.build.body: Drag, resize and experiment. Your construction is your answer.
home.how.understand.body: Feedback explains what your answer actually does, with hints when you need them.
catalog.title: Courses
catalog.subtitle: Interactive courses for grades 9–12. Filter by subject or grade.
catalog.empty: No courses match these filters yet.
course.outcomes: What you'll be able to do
placement.title: Find your level
placement.intro: Answer about 10 questions. Each answer chooses the next question, so it adapts to you. There's no score to pass — "I don't know yet" is a perfectly good answer.
placement.uncertain: Estimate — it gets sharper as you learn.
placement.answered: {count, plural, one {Based on # answer} other {Based on # answers}}
lesson.buildHint: Build your answer on the board, then press Check.
footer.local: Your progress is stored on this device.
ui.assumption.pendulumLab.0: Point mass on a massless, rigid rod
ui.assumption.pendulumLab.2: No air resistance except the optional linear damping term
ui.grid.handle: {shape} corner at {x}, {y}. Use the arrow keys to move it.
ui.pend.aria: Pendulum: length {length} m, gravity {gravity} m/s², angle {angle}°.
ui.pend.reducedMotion: Reduced motion is on — the periods above are still computed exactly.
sort.noSwaps: No swaps in this pass — the array is sorted
sort.isSmaller: Is {a} smaller than the current minimum {min}?
feedback.choice.partial: Partly right — check your selection again.
feedback.numeric.unreadable: That doesn't look like a number.
feedback.numeric.sign: Check the sign of your answer.
feedback.numeric.magnitude: Right digits, wrong magnitude — check your units or decimal point.
feedback.expression.notEquivalent: Not equivalent to the expected expression.
feedback.goal.degenerate: That shape is flat or crosses itself — spread its corners apart.
feedback.goal.metric: Its {metric} is {actual}, but it needs to be {op} {value}.

ui.circuit.switch: {name} is {state}. Press Enter to flip it.
ui.circuit.short: Short circuit! The battery's two ends are joined by wire alone.
ui.circuit.invalid: These batteries are working against each other.
ui.circuit.hint: Tap a dashed gap (or press Enter) to choose what goes there. Tap a switch to flip it.
ui.assumption.circuitBoard.0: Batteries are ideal (fixed voltage, no internal resistance), except that a shorted battery's voltage collapses
ui.assumption.circuitBoard.1: Bulbs behave like fixed resistors (6 Ω); real filaments change resistance as they heat up
ui.assumption.circuitBoard.2: Wires and closed switches have (almost) no resistance
ui.assumption.circuitBoard.3: Steady direct current only: no capacitors, inductors or changing signals
feedback.circuit.short: Short circuit! The battery's two ends are joined by wire alone, so current rushes around that path and skips everything else. Remove the shortcut.
feedback.circuit.invalid: These batteries are working against each other, so the circuit can't settle. Rearrange them.
feedback.circuit.dark: Bulb {part} isn't lit yet. Current needs a complete loop through it.
feedback.circuit.lit: Bulb {part} is lit, but it should be dark.
feedback.circuit.total: The battery delivers {actual} A, but it needs to be {op} {value} A.
feedback.circuit.metric: {part}: the {metric} is {actual} {unit}, but it needs to be {op} {value} {unit}.
ui.nl.unplaced: Point {label} is not on the line yet. Press an arrow key to place it.
ui.nl.placed: Point {label} at {value}. Use the arrow keys to move it.
ui.nl.hint: Drag a point (or use the arrow keys). It snaps to the marks.
feedback.numberLine.empty: Place the points on the line first.
feedback.numberLine.value: {point} is at {actual}, but it needs to be at {value}.
feedback.numberLine.bound: {point} is at {actual}; it needs to be {op} {value}.
ui.bal.tippedLeft: Tipped: the left side is heavier
ui.bal.tippedRight: Tipped: the right side is heavier
ui.bal.addX: Add an x to the {side} pan
ui.bal.removeX: Take an x off the {side} pan
ui.bal.moveX: Take an x from both sides
feedback.balance.unbalanced: The pans aren't level: the left side is worth {left} and the right side {right}.
feedback.balance.tipped: The pans aren't level, so the two sides aren't equal.
feedback.balance.notSolved: Balanced, but x isn't alone yet. Keep doing the same thing to both sides.
